newsitem.title: USA: Two Texas teens dead in double suicide.
newsitem.headline: Two Texas teens dead in double suicide.

text.p: Two teenage sweethearts shot themselves in the head in a suicide pact, Texas police said Tuesday.
Angela James, 15, and Gary Dean, 14, killed themselves in a bedroom at Dean's home in the Fort Worth suburb of Dalworthington Gardens on Monday evening.
"Our preliminary investigation of the case indicates that the wounds were self-inflicted," a spokesman said.
The two teenagers had apparently been dating for several months and left an audio tape and letters behind, but there was no indication of why they decided to commit suicide.
About 30 counsellors were sent to the teenagers' high school to help grieving classmates.
